questions.question: Simplify: (3x - 2)² - (x + 4)²
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the algebraic identity a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b).

Here, a = 3x − 2 and b = x + 4.

(a − b) = (3x − 2) − (x + 4) = 2x − 6.

(a + b) = (3x − 2) + (x + 4) = 4x + 2.

Product = (2x − 6)(4x + 2) = 8x² + 4x − 24x − 12 = 8x² − 20x − 12.

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given Expression: (3x − 2)² − (x + 4)²

Formula Used: (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b² and (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

⇒ Expansion of (3x − 2)² = (3x)² − 2(3x)(2) + 2²

⇒ (3x − 2)² = 9x² − 12x + 4

⇒ Expansion of (x + 4)² = x² + 2(x)(4) + 4²

⇒ (x + 4)² = x² + 8x + 16

⇒ Expression = (9x² − 12x + 4) − (x² + 8x + 16)

⇒ 9x² − 12x + 4 − x² − 8x − 16

⇒ (9x² − x²) + (−12x − 8x) + (4 − 16)

⇒ 8x² − 20x − 12

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference of Two Squares

The identity a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b) is one of the most efficient ways to simplify the difference of two squared binomials.

Standard Binomial Expansion

For any terms a and b, (a ± b)² = a² ± 2ab + b². Always remember to distribute the negative sign when subtracting a whole expansion.

Combining Like Terms

Only terms with the same variable and same exponent (e.g., x² with x²) can be added or subtracted by performing operations on their coefficients.

questions.question: When x is added to each of 17, 9, 26 and 14, then the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. Then, if 8x : y :: y : (4x - 2) , and y > 0 , what is the value of y ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Shortcut formula for x: x = |ad − bc| / |(a + d) − (b + c)|

x = |17 × 14 − 9 × 26| / |(17 + 14) − (9 + 26)| = |238 − 234| / |31 − 35| = 4 / 4 = 1

Given 8x : y :: y : (4x − 2) ⇒ y² = 8x × (4x − 2)

y² = 8(1) × (4(1) − 2) = 8 × 2 = 16 ⇒ y = 4

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers 17, 9, 26, 14; x is added to each; 8x : y :: y : (4x − 2).

**Formula:** If a, b, c, d are in proportion, then a/b = c/d.

 (17 + x) : (9 + x) = (26 + x) : (14 + x) 
• 8x y 4x−2 Mean Proportion: y² = 8x × (4x − 2)

⇒ (17 + x) / (9 + x) = (26 + x) / (14 + x)

⇒ (17 + x)(14 + x) = (26 + x)(9 + x)

⇒ 238 + 17x + 14x + x² = 234 + 26x + 9x + x²

⇒ 238 + 31x = 234 + 35x

⇒ 35x − 31x = 238 − 234

⇒ 4x = 4 ⇒ x = 1

⇒ y² = 8x × (4x − 2)

⇒ y² = 8(1) × (4(1) − 2) = 8 × 2 = 16

⇒ y = √16 = 4

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is √(a × b). If a : y :: y : b, then y is the mean proportional.

Fourth Proportional

If a, b, and c are three numbers, the fourth proportional d is calculated as d = (b × c) / a, such that a : b :: c : d.

Invertendo Property

If a : b :: c : d, then by invertendo, b : a :: d : c. This means if a/b = c/d, then b/a = d/c.

questions.question: If the radius of the base of a right circular cylinder is decreased by 12% and its height is increased by 169%, then what is the percentage increase (closest integer) in its volume?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net change in Volume = [Net change in r²] + [Change in h]

Net change in r² = −12 − 12 + (−12 × −12)/100 = −22.56%

Total change in Volume = −22.56 + 169 + (−22.56 × 169)/100

Total change = 146.44 − 38.12 = 108.32%

As a ratio, 108% increase corresponds to 1.08.

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Decrease in Radius (r) = 12%

Increase in Height (h) = 169%

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Cylinder (V) = πr²h

 
 Original (V) h 
• r 
 New (2.08V) 2.69h 
• 0.88r Net Volume Increase ≈ 108% 

Let original radius be r and height be h.

⇒ Initial Volume (V₁) = πr²h

⇒ New radius (r') = r − 0.12r = 0.88r

⇒ New height (h') = h + 1.69h = 2.69h

⇒ New Volume (V₂) = π × (0.88r)² × (2.69h)

⇒ V₂ = π × 0.7744r² × 2.69h

⇒ V₂ = 2.083136 × (πr²h)

⇒ Volume Increase = V₂ − V₁ = 2.083136V₁ − V₁ = 1.083136V₁

⇒ Percentage Increase = 1.083136 × 100 = 108.31%

⇒ Closest integer = 108% (or 1.08 as a ratio)

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cylinder Formulas

Volume = πr²h | Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh | Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(h + r).

Successive Percentage Change

For two changes x% and y%, the net change is given by (x + y + xy/100)%.

Volume Change Proportionality

Volume is directly proportional to r² and h. If r changes by factor k₁ and h by k₂, Volume changes by factor k₁² × k₂.

 CP (100%)

 Loss: 10% SP (90%) ₹? ₹2,700 

Calculations:

⇒ CP = [2,700 × 100] ÷ [100 − 10]

Marked Price and CP Relation

CP ÷ MP = [100 − Discount%] ÷ [100 + Profit%].

questions.question: Two pumps, M and N, can fill a tank in 36 hours and 45 hours, respectively. Another pump P can empty the tank in 30 hours. First M and N are opened, and after 8 hours, P is also opened. The tank will be filled up in total T hours. The value of T is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total capacity = LCM(36, 45, 30) = 180 units.

Efficiencies: M = 5, N = 4, P = −6 (emptying).

In 8 hours, M + N fill: (5 + 4) × 8 = 72 units.

Remaining work = 180 − 72 = 108 units.

Time with all pumps = 108 ÷ (5 + 4 − 6) = 108 ÷ 3 = 36 hours.

Total time T = 8 + 36 = 44 hours.

**∴ The correct option is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by M = 36 hours

Time taken by N = 45 hours

Time taken by P = 30 hours (emptying)

Initial duration for M and N = 8 hours

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

questions.question: If 50\% of 60\% of (2)/(7) of a number is 618 , find the number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert percentages to fractions: 50% = 1/2 and 60% = 3/5.

Fractional product = 1/2 × 3/5 × 2/7 = 3/35 of the number.

Given: 3 units = 618

1 unit = 618 ÷ 3 = 206

Number (35 units) = 206 × 35 = 7210.

**∴ The correct answer is 7210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

50% of 60% of 2/7 of a number = 618

**Formula Used:**

x% of y = (x/100) × y

 Original Number (x) 2/7 Part 
• 60% (3/5) of 2/7 50% (1/2) of 60% of 2/7 
 3/35 of x = 618 x = 7210 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the number be x.

⇒ (50/100) × (60/100) × (2/7) × x = 618

⇒ (1/2) × (3/5) × (2/7) × x = 618

⇒ (3/35) × x = 618

⇒ x = (618 × 35) ÷ 3

⇒ x = 206 × 35

⇒ x = 7210

**∴ The correct answer is 7210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To simplify calculations, memorize standard fractions: 25% = 1/4, 33.33% = 1/3, 40% = 2/5, 75% = 3/4, 80% = 4/5.

Successive Percentage Application

When multiple percentages are applied to a single base value, they can be multiplied directly as fractions: Total fraction = f₁ × f₂ × f₃.

Finding the Base Number

If a fraction (a/b) of a number is equal to V, then the original number is (V × b) ÷ a.

questions.question: If the ratio of two numbers is 2 : 5, and their HCF is 29, then their LCM is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM = HCF × Product of co-prime ratios

LCM = 29 × (2 × 5)

LCM = 29 × 10 = 290

**∴ The correct answer is 290.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Ratio = 2 : 5, HCF = 29

Formula: LCM = HCF × a × b (where a, b are co-prime ratios)

 Number 1 (2 × HCF) Number 2 (5 × HCF) 
• LCM = 29 × 2 × 5 = 290 

⇒ Let the numbers be 2x and 5x, where x is the HCF.

⇒ x = 29

⇒ First Number = 2 × 29 = 58

⇒ Second Number = 5 × 29 = 145

⇒ LCM = 29 × 2 × 5

⇒ LCM = 290

**∴ The correct answer is 290.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Relation

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM. This applies only to two numbers.

Ratio and HCF

If two numbers are in the ratio a : b and their HCF is H, then the numbers are Ha and Hb. Their LCM is H × a × b.

Co-prime Numbers

Numbers whose HCF is 1 are called co-prime numbers. The LCM of co-prime numbers is equal to their product.

questions.question: After selling an article at a discount of 4%, the profit percentage obtained is 20%. What is the markup percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct ratio: CP : MP = (100 − Discount%) : (100 + Profit%)

CP : MP = (100 − 4) : (100 + 20)

CP : MP = 96 : 120 = 4 : 5

Markup = 5 − 4 = 1 unit on CP of 4 units

Markup percentage = 1/4 = 0.25

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Discount = 4%, Profit = 20%

Formula: Selling Price (SP) = CP × (1 + Profit%) and SP = MP × (1 − Discount%)

 CP (100) SP (120) MP (125) 
 +20% Profit 
 −4% Discount Markup = MP − CP = 25 

⇒ Let Cost Price (CP) = 100

⇒ Profit = 20% ⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 100 + 20 = 120

⇒ Discount = 4% on Marked Price (MP) ⇒ SP = 96% of MP

⇒ 0.96 × MP = 120

⇒ MP = 120 / 0.96 = 125

⇒ Markup = MP − CP = 125 − 100 = 25

⇒ Markup percentage = 25 / 100 = 0.25

**∴ The correct option is D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

CP and MP Relationship

The ratio of Marked Price to Cost Price is given by MP/CP = (100 + Profit%) / (100 − Discount%).

Successive Discount Formula

If two successive discounts of d₁% and d₂% are given, the total discount is (d₁ + d₂ − d₁×d₂/100)%.

Markup Percentage

Markup percentage is calculated on the Cost Price: Markup% = [(MP − CP) / CP] × 100.

questions.question:
Simplify :

 (1-sec x)/(csc x · cot x)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put x = 60° in the expression: (1 − sec 60°) / (csc 60° × cot 60°)

⇒ (1 − 2) / (2/√3 × 1/√3) = −1 / (2/3) = −3/2

Check Option C: (cos 60° − 1) tan² 60° = (1/2 − 1) × (√3)² = (−1/2) × 3 = −3/2

Since the values match, Option C is the correct simplification.

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Expression = (1 − sec x) / (csc x × cot x)

Formula Used: sec x = 1/cos x, csc x = 1/sin x, cot x = cos x / sin x, tan x = sin x / cos x

⇒ (1 − 1/cos x) / [(1/sin x) × (cos x / sin x)]

⇒ [(cos x − 1) / cos x] / [cos x / sin² x]

⇒ [(cos x − 1) / cos x] × [sin² x / cos x]

⇒ (cos x − 1) × [sin² x / cos² x]

⇒ (cos x − 1) tan² x

**∴ The correct option is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identities

sin²x + cos²x = 1, 1 + tan²x = sec²x, and 1 + cot²x = csc²x.

Reciprocal Identities

sec x = 1/cos x, csc x = 1/sin x, and cot x = 1/tan x.

Quotient Identities

tan x = sin x / cos x and cot x = cos x / sin x.

questions.question: Simplify: [24 - {6 + 3² - (4 times overline{2 + 1})}] div 3 + 5 times 2
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve V-BODMAS inside-out:

Vinculum → (2 + 1) = 3; then (4 × 3) = 12

Curly → 6 + 3² − 12 → 15 − 12 = 3

Square → 24 − 3 = 21

Expression → 21 ÷ 3 + (5 × 2) = 7 + 10 = 17

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** [24 − {6 + 3² − (4 × 2 + 1)}] ÷ 3 + 5 × 2

**Formula Used:** V-BODMAS Rule (Vinculum, Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ [24 − {6 + 9 − (4 × (2 + 1))}] ÷ 3 + 10

⇒ [24 − {15 − (4 × 3)}] ÷ 3 + 10

⇒ [24 − {15 − 12}] ÷ 3 + 10

⇒ [24 − 3] ÷ 3 + 10

⇒ 21 ÷ 3 + 10

⇒ 7 + 10

⇒ 17

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

V-BODMAS Rule

It specifies the order of operations: Vinculum (Bar), Brackets (), {}, [], Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Vinculum Property

A vinculum or bar over an expression indicates that it must be computed first, even before the innermost brackets.

Bracket Priority

The standard hierarchy is to solve circular/small brackets () first, then curly/braces {}, and finally square brackets [].

questions.question: A and B working together can complete a piece of work in 2 days. B alone can complete the same work in 10 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to complete double the work?2524
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(2, 10) = 10 units

Efficiency of (A + B) = 10/2 = 5 units/day

Efficiency of B = 10/10 = 1 unit/day

Efficiency of A = 5 − 1 = 4 units/day

Time for A to do double work (20 units) = 20 ÷ 4 = 5 days

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by (A + B) together = 2 days

Time taken by B alone = 10 days

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of A = Efficiency (A+B) − Efficiency (B)

⇒ Efficiency of A = 5 − 1 = 4 units/day

⇒ Total work to be completed = 2 × 10 = 20 units

⇒ Time taken by A for double work = 20 ÷ 4

⇒ Time = 5 days

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relation

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time for a constant amount of work (E₁ × T₁ = E₂ × T₂).

Combined Work Formula

If two people A and B take x and y days respectively, together they take (x × y) ÷ (x + y) days.

Work & Wages

Wages are distributed in the ratio of the work done by each individual, which is the same as the ratio of their efficiencies if they work for the same duration.

questions.question: A train 1386 m long is running at 18 km/hr. How long will it take to clear a 564 m long platform completely?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Distance = Train Length + Platform Length = 1386 + 564 = 1950 m

Speed = 18 km/hr = 18 × 5/18 = 5 m/s

Time = 1950 ÷ 5 = 390 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 390 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Length of Train (L₁) = 1386 m

Length of Platform (L₂) = 564 m

Speed of Train (S) = 18 km/hr

 Train (1386 m) Platform (564 m) 
• 
• 
• Total Distance = 1386 + 564 = 1950 m Speed = 18 km/hr → 5 m/s 

Formula Used:

Time = Total Distance ÷ Speed

Calculations:

⇒ Total distance to be covered = L₁ + L₂

⇒ Total Distance = 1386 + 564 = 1950 m

⇒ Speed in m/s = 18 × (5/18) = 5 m/s

⇒ Time taken = 1950 ÷ 5

⇒ Time taken = 390 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 390 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two objects move in the same direction with speeds u and v, relative speed = |u − v|.

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two objects move in opposite directions with speeds u and v, relative speed = u + v.

Crossing a Pole/Point Object

When a train crosses a pole or a stationary man, the distance covered is equal to the length of the train itself.

questions.question:
The total surface area of a sphere is 6006 cm² less than the total surface area of a hemisphere. If the ratio between the radii of the hemisphere and sphere is 5 : 3, then find the radius of the sphere.

 (Use pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of radii (Hemisphere : Sphere) = 5 : 3

Total Surface Area (TSA) units ratio = (3 × 5²) : (4 × 3²) = 75 : 36

Difference in TSA units = 75 − 36 = 39 units

39 × (π × x²) = 6006 ⇒ 39 × (22/7) × x² = 6006

x² = (6006 × 7) / (39 × 22) = 49 ⇒ x = 7

Radius of sphere = 3 × 7 = 21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference in TSA = 6006 cm²

Ratio of radii (rₕ : rₛ) = 5 : 3

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Total surface area of sphere = 4πr²

Total surface area of hemisphere = 3πr²

 
• rₛ = 3x Sphere 
 
• rₕ = 5x Hemisphere TSA Difference = 6006 cm²

**Calculations:**

Let the radius of the hemisphere be rₕ = 5x and the radius of the sphere be rₛ = 3x.

⇒ TSA of hemisphere − TSA of sphere = 6006

⇒ 3πrₕ² − 4πrₛ² = 6006

⇒ π [3 × (5x)² − 4 × (3x)²] = 6006

⇒ (22/7) [3 × 25x² − 4 × 9x²] = 6006

⇒ (22/7) [75x² − 36x²] = 6006

⇒ (22/7) × 39x² = 6006

⇒ 39x² = (6006 × 7) / 22

⇒ 39x² = 273 × 7

⇒ x² = (273 × 7) / 39

⇒ x² = 7 × 7 = 49

⇒ x = √49 = 7

⇒ Radius of sphere (rₛ) = 3x = 3 × 7 = 21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Sphere

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = Total Surface Area (TSA) = 4πr². Volume = (4/3)πr³.

Properties of Hemisphere

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πr². Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3πr². Volume = (2/3)πr³.

Ratio of TSA and Radius

If the radius is multiplied by a factor k, the surface area is multiplied by k² and the volume by k³.

questions.question: The data 30, 33, 49, 51, x, x + 4, 73, 79, 85, 96 is arranged in the ascending order and the median of the data is 64. Find the value of x.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an even number of terms (n = 10), the median is the average of the two middle terms.

The middle terms are the 5th (x) and 6th (x + 4) terms.

Median = Average of x and x + 4 = x + 2.

Given Median = 64 ⇒ x + 2 = 64.

⇒ x = 62.

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data: 30, 33, 49, 51, x, x + 4, 73, 79, 85, 96 (Arranged in ascending order)

Number of observations (n) = 10

Median = 64

**Formula Used:**

When n is even, Median = [(n/2)th term + (n/2 + 1)th term] ÷ 2

 
• x (5th) x + 4 (6th) 
• Median = 64 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Median = (5th term + 6th term) ÷ 2

⇒ 64 = (x + x + 4) ÷ 2

⇒ 64 × 2 = 2x + 4

⇒ 128 = 2x + 4

⇒ 2x = 128 − 4

⇒ 2x = 124

⇒ x = 124 ÷ 2

⇒ x = 62

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median for Odd Observations

If n is odd, the median is the ((n + 1)/2)th term when data is arranged in order.

Mean (Average)

Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Range of Data

Range = Maximum value − Minimum value.

Empirical Formula

Relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks the price of an article at ₹1,980. Find the cost price if after allowing a discount of 12% he still gains 32% on the cost price.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct ratio: CP / MP = (100 − Discount%) / (100 + Profit%)

⇒ CP / 1980 = (100 − 12) / (100 + 32)

⇒ CP / 1980 = 88 / 132

⇒ CP / 1980 = 2 / 3

⇒ CP = 1980 × (2 / 3) = 660 × 2 = 1320

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,320.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹1,980

Discount = 12%

Profit = 32%

**Formula:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − Discount%)/100

Cost Price (CP) = SP × 100/(100 + Profit%)

 
• CP SP MP 
 +32% Profit 
 −12% Discount MP = ₹1,980 CP = ? 
 

**Step 1: Calculate Selling Price (SP)**

⇒ SP = 1,980 × (100 − 12) / 100

⇒ SP = 1,980 × 88 / 100

⇒ SP = 1,980 × 0.88 = ₹1,742.40

**Step 2: Calculate Cost Price (CP)**

⇒ CP = 1,742.40 × 100 / (100 + 32)

⇒ CP = 1,742.40 × 100 / 132

⇒ CP = 174,240 / 132

⇒ CP = ₹1,320

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,320.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relation between CP and MP

CP / MP = (100 − D%) / (100 + P%). This is the fastest way to solve questions involving both discount and profit.

Marked Price (MP)

MP = CP + Markup. Markup % = (Markup / CP) × 100. It is the price listed on the tag before discounts.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts d₁% and d₂% are given, total discount = [d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂)/100]%.

questions.question: The average age of 37 students of a class is 42 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 43 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:

Number of initial members = 37

Increase in average = 43 − 42 = 1 year

Age of Teacher = 43 + (37 × 1) = 80 years

Number of students = 37

Average age of students = 42 years

New average including teacher = 43 years

Total number of people = 37 + 1 = 38

questions.question: If ₹8,404 is divided between Rishi and Yash in the ratio 7 : 15, then find the share of Yash (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total units in ratio = 7 + 15 = 22

22 units = ₹8,404

1 unit = 8,404 ÷ 22 = 382

Yash's share (15 units) = 15 × 382 = 5,730

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount to be divided = ₹8,404

Ratio of Rishi : Yash = 7 : 15

**Formula Used:**

Individual Share = (Individual Ratio ÷ Sum of Ratios) × Total Amount

 Rishi Yash 7 units 15 units 
 Total = 22 units = ₹8,404 
• 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of ratio parts = 7 + 15 = 22

⇒ Yash's share = (15 ÷ 22) × 8,404

⇒ Yash's share = 15 × (8,404 ÷ 22)

⇒ Yash's share = 15 × 382

⇒ Yash's share = 5,730

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

A ratio compares two quantities of the same unit. If a : b is a ratio, then a is the antecedent and b is the consequent.

Dividing a Quantity

To divide a quantity Q in the ratio x : y, the parts are [x ÷ (x+y)] × Q and [y ÷ (x+y)] × Q.

Duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a : b is a² : b², and the sub-duplicate ratio is √a : √b.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is √(a × b).

questions.question: The price of 1 kg of carrot on Monday is ₹40. If it is increased by 5% and 3% on the next two consecutive days, then what is its price (in ₹) on Wednesday?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Percentage Increase = a + b + (a × b / 100)

Successive Increase = 5 + 3 + (5 × 3 / 100) = 8.15%

Price on Wednesday = 40 + (8.15% of 40)

⇒ 40 + 3.26 = 43.26

**∴ The correct answer is 43.26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 ₹40 Monday 
• +5% ₹42 Tuesday 
• +3% ₹43.26 Wednesday 
 

Given:

Initial Price (Monday) = ₹40

Increase on Tuesday = 5%

Increase on Wednesday = 3%

Formula: Final Price = Initial Price × (1 + r₁/100) × (1 + r₂/100)

⇒ Price on Tuesday = 40 × (1 + 5/100)

⇒ Price on Tuesday = 40 × 1.05 = ₹42

⇒ Price on Wednesday = 42 × (1 + 3/100)

⇒ Price on Wednesday = 42 × 1.03

⇒ Price on Wednesday = ₹43.26

**∴ The correct answer is 43.26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is changed by a% and then by b%, the net change is given by (a + b + ab/100)%.

Multiplier Factor

An x% increase is equivalent to multiplying the initial value by (1 + x/100). For example, a 5% increase means multiplying by 1.05.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of d₁% and d₂% are given, the single equivalent discount is (d₁ + d₂ − d₁d₂/100)%.

questions.question: Two banks, A and B, offered loans at 3.5% and 7.5% per annum, respectively. Mukund borrowed an amount of ₹2,00,000 from each bank. Find the positive difference (in ₹) between the amounts of simple interest paid to the two banks by Mukund after 2 years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate difference per year = 7.5% − 3.5% = 4%.

Interest difference for 1 year = 4% of 2,00,000 = 8,000.

Interest difference for 2 years = 8,000 × 2 = 16,000.

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,00,000

Rate 1 (R₁) = 3.5% p.a. | Rate 2 (R₂) = 7.5% p.a.

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 Principal ₹2,00,000 
• 
• Bank A (3.5%) SI = ₹14,000 Bank B (7.5%) SI = ₹30,000 
 Difference: ₹16,000 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI paid to Bank A = (2,00,000 × 3.5 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ SI paid to Bank A = 2,000 × 7 = ₹14,000

⇒ SI paid to Bank B = (2,00,000 × 7.5 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ SI paid to Bank B = 2,000 × 15 = ₹30,000

⇒ Difference = ₹30,000 − ₹14,000

⇒ Difference = ₹16,000

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference in Simple Interest

When the principal and time are the same, the difference in SI for two different rates R₁ and R₂ is given by P × T × (R₁ − R₂) ÷ 100.

Effective Interest Rate

The effective interest rate for a period is R × T%. For example, 3.5% for 2 years results in a total interest of 7% of the principal.

Total Amount in SI

Amount (A) = P + SI = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

questions.question: The cost of a washing machine is 50% less than the cost of a TV. If the cost of the washing machine increases by 76% and that of the TV decreases by 28%, then what is the percentage change in the total cost of 4 washing machines and 2 TVs?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Unit Cost (Washing Machine : TV) = 1 : 2

Total Weightage (4 WM : 2 TV) = (4 × 1) : (2 × 2) = 4 : 4 = 1 : 1

Since weightage of both components is equal, Net % Change = Average of changes

Net % Change = (76% − 28%) ÷ 2 = 48% ÷ 2 = 24%

**∴ The correct answer is Increase by 24%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** WM cost = 50% less than TV cost. WM cost change = +76%, TV cost change = −28%.

**Formula Used:** % Change = (New Total − Old Total) ÷ Old Total × 100

 Initial Total Cost: 4 WM (200x) 2 TV (200x) 400x New Total Cost: 4 WM (+76%) = 352x 2 TV (−28%) 144x 496x 
• Net Increase = 496x − 400x = 96x (24%) 

⇒ Let Cost of 1 TV = 100x

⇒ Cost of 1 Washing Machine = 100x − 50% of 100x = 50x

⇒ Total Initial Cost (4 WM + 2 TV) = 4(50x) + 2(100x) = 200x + 200x = 400x

⇒ New Cost of 1 WM = 50x + 76% of 50x = 50x + 38x = 88x

⇒ New Cost of 1 TV = 100x − 28% of 100x = 72x

⇒ New Total Cost = 4(88x) + 2(72x) = 352x + 144x = 496x

⇒ Percentage Change = [(496x − 400x) ÷ 400x] × 100

⇒ (96 ÷ 400) × 100 = 24%

**∴ The correct answer is Increase by 24%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change Formula

Percentage change = [(Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100. A positive result indicates an increase, while negative indicates a decrease.

Weighted Average Percentage

Total % Change = (w₁p₁ + w₂p₂ + ... + wₙpₙ) ÷ (w₁ + w₂ + ... + wₙ), where w is weight and p is percentage change.

Successive Percentage Change

If a value changes by a% and then b%, the net change is given by [a + b + (ab ÷ 100)]%.
